CustomField.description:
This formula will traverse the Account hierarchy from (including) current record all the way to the top (up to 6 levels) and will display the value of the "Information Governance Rep" field of the parent Account where IM_HIerarchy_Level__c field is "IM Group (IMGA)". If there is no such level parent in the hierarchy - will leave field blank.
#26452 : Account Coverage: Relabel Primary BDE, Insight Owner and Entertainment Services Owner and Hide other retired "Owner" fields Digital Business Unit Solution Development Executive (SDE). - Set at the Country Parent and cascades down to the Sales Site.
#26660: To copy data from Country Parent Account to Sales Site and this data is further used in AccountCoverageFieldsSync Apex job to update Lookup field(Information_Governance_Rep__c) #31465: Data should not be wiped off on Orphan Sales Site Accounts
CustomField.label: DBU SDE (Formula)
